## Summary

<!-- Describe the change and the user or maintenance problem it addresses. -->

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] User-facing feature or improvement
- [ ] Security or privacy
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, packaging or CI
- [ ] Refactoring / maintenance

## Verification

<!-- List the commands and checks actually run, with relevant results. -->

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Linting / formatting checks pass, where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behaviour or workflows changed.
- [ ] User-visible changes are recorded in `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No new network transfer of user content, or the transfer is documented in `SECURITY.md`.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or generated sensitive artifacts are included.

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `feature` (unless an explicitly documented automation or release workflow requires another target).
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated modifications.
- [ ] I have reviewed the contribution guidance and project Code of Conduct.
